analysis.summary: Supreme Power Equipment Limited reported a strong H1 FY27 performance with income growing by 79.91% year-on-year to INR135.57 crores and EBITDA increasing by 65.46% to INR23.62 crores. Management noted robust demand driven by transmission and distribution infrastructure and highlighted an order book exceeding INR565.80 crores. For the full year FY27, the company expects revenue between INR300 crores and INR350 crores and a PAT margin range of 9% to 12%. Operationally, the ramp-up of the Kannur manufacturing facility is progressing well, with peak utilization potential estimated at INR550 crores to INR600 crores next year. Supreme Power Equipment Limited reported strong H1 FY27 results with total income growing 79.91% YoY to ₹135.57 Cr and Net Profit increasing 45.09% YoY to ₹13.65 Cr.

guidance.claim: The company expects full year revenue to be between INR300 crores and INR350 crores.
guidance.quote: This year, we believe -- we trust we should fetch revenue between INR300 crores and INR350 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects the PAT margin to be maintained in the range of 9% to 12%.
guidance.quote: And based on the order book, the margin can be maintained between -- the PAT margin can be maintained between 9% to 12%.

guidance.claim: The closing order book by year-end is expected to be between INR600 crores and INR800 crores.
guidance.quote: With that, I think we believe, with the end of the year, we may maintain between -- the order book may maintain between INR600 crores and INR800 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects net profit margin (PAT) to be maintained between 10% and 12%.
guidance.quote: We believe it will be maintained or sustained between 10% to 12%.

guidance.claim: EBITDA margins are expected to be maintained between 18% and 20%.
Management targets a minimum year-on-year revenue growth of 30%.
guidance.quote: Year-on-year, 30% -- minimum 30% rise will be there on the revenue.

guidance.claim: Total revenue is projected to reach INR 550 crores to INR 600 crores in FY29.
guidance.quote: The total revenue may come to INR600 crores, INR550 crores to INR600 crores in FY29.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand environment across the transformer industry is very good.
demand_outlook.quote: We are encouraged by the demand environment across the transformer industry, supported by continued investments in transmission and distribution infrastructure, renewable energy integration and industrial expansion.

demand_outlook.claim: Market information indicates good demand for the power sector for the next 8 to 10 years.
demand_outlook.quote: As per market information, next 8 to 10 years, there will be good demand for this power sector.

demand_outlook.claim: The strong growth reflects healthy execution of our order book and continued demand across our key markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The strong growth reflects healthy execution of our order book and continued demand across our key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Overall, business momentum remains encouraging, and we continue to progress in line with our targets for the year.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, business momentum remains encouraging, and we continue to progress in line with our targets for the year.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for 220 kV transformers across India is very high.
demand_outlook.quote: For 220 kV transformers, number of players are less compared to all pan-India, number of players are less. But anyhow, demand is very high. Demand is very high.

demand_outlook.claim: Market demand for transformers is expected to sustain for at least 10 years.
demand_outlook.quote: From the market information, at least minimum 10 years, this demand will sustain.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects to secure another INR 300 crores to INR 500 crores of orders currently under negotiation.
demand_outlook.quote: Yes, we are expecting another INR300 crores to INR500 crores order, which we have already quoted and negotiation in the various stages.

capex_expansion.claim: The ramp-up of the Kannur manufacturing facility is progressing well.
capex_expansion.quote: Operationally, the ramp-up of our Kannur manufacturing facility is progressing well.

capex_expansion.claim: Both plants combined have a peak revenue potential of INR550 crores to INR600 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, up to INR550 crores to INR600 crores will be the peak revenue.

capex_expansion.claim: The ramp-up of our newly inaugurated Kannur facility is progressing well, with production and capacity utilisation scaling up as planned.
capex_expansion.quote: The ramp-up of our newly inaugurated Kannur facility is progressing well, with production and capacity utilisation scaling up as planned.

capex_expansion.claim: Supreme Power plans to build a tank manufacturing facility with an estimated capex of INR 20 crores to INR 22 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, it's around INR20 crores, INR22 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects to complete the construction of the tank manufacturing facility before March.
capex_expansion.quote: I think before March, I think this facility will complete.

capex_expansion.claim: The operationalization of the Kannur facility enhanced total capacity to approximately 9,000 MVA.
capex_expansion.quote: I would all like to brief touch upon our new Kannur manufacturing facility, which became operational during the previous quarter. The facility has strengthened our overall manufacturing capacity to approximately 9,000 MVA with capabilities extending up to 200 MVA, 220 kV.

margins_costs.claim: During the period, the company faced pressure from higher prices of key inputs such as CRGO steel and transformer oil.
margins_costs.quote: During the period, we have seen pressure from higher prices of key inputs, particularly CRGO steel and transformer oil.

margins_costs.claim: Around 70% to 75% of the order book is covered under price variation clauses.
margins_costs.quote: Importantly, around 70% to 75% of our order book is covered under price variation clauses, which provides a degree of protection against volatility in key raw material prices.

margins_costs.claim: Margins witnessed some pressure during H1 FY27, primarily due to the inflationary environment and higher input costs, particularly across key raw materials.
margins_costs.quote: Margins witnessed some pressure during H1 FY27, primarily due to the inflationary environment and higher input costs, particularly across key raw materials.

margins_costs.claim: However, around 70–75% of our order book is covered by price variation clauses, which provides protection against significant movements in raw material prices and helps us manage cost volatility over the execution period.
margins_costs.quote: However, around 70–75% of our order book is covered by price variation clauses, which provides protection against significant movements in raw material prices and helps us manage cost volatility over the execution period.

margins_costs.claim: We remain focused on procurement efficiency, better product mix and operating leverage as volumes scale up.
margins_costs.quote: We remain focused on procurement efficiency, better product mix and operating leverage as volumes scale up.

margins_costs.claim: In Q1 FY27, EBITDA margin was 18.4% and net profit margin was 10.14%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR8.89 crores, growing 32.2% year-on-year with an EBITDA margin of 18.4%.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material price increases were offset using price variation clauses in customer contracts.
margins_costs.quote: Since we took orders mostly with the price variation clause. And though there was a geopolitical issues were there due to that, the price rise of the raw materials are being absorbed because of this price variation clause, which we get from our buyers.

margins_costs.claim: Employee benefit expenses increased due to deploying additional personnel for the new manufacturing plant.
margins_costs.quote: So now we have deployed more people for the new unit. So naturally, the employee benefits will high.

margins_costs.claim: Approximately 80% to 85% of the order book is protected by price variation clauses.
margins_costs.quote: Most of the order we have price variation clause. Almost 80%, 85% order which we are holding is covered with price variation clause.

orders_capacity.claim: During H1 FY27, the company secured 11 orders aggregating INR209.24 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: During H1 FY27, we secured 11 orders aggregating INR209.24 crores, with execution timelines ranging between 7 months and 17 months.

orders_capacity.claim: The current order book stands at over INR565.80 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current order book stands at over INR565.80 crores, providing strong execution visibility for the coming periods.

orders_capacity.claim: Distribution transformers account for 16% to 17%, power transformers around 75% to 78%, and inverter duty transformers around 5% of the total order book.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of this INR565 crores, distribution is around 16% to 17%, that is less than INR95 crores. And power transformer is around INR440 crores that comes around 78% -- 75% to 78%. And inverter duty transformers is around INR30 crores, that comes 5% of the total order book.

orders_capacity.claim: Our order inflow remained healthy during the first half.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order inflow remained healthy during the first half.

orders_capacity.claim: We secured 11 orders with a cumulative value of ₹209.24 Cr, with execution timelines ranging from 7 to 17 months.
orders_capacity.quote: We secured 11 orders with a cumulative value of ₹209.24 Cr, with execution timelines ranging from 7 to 17 months.

orders_capacity.claim: Our current order book stands at ₹565.80 Cr, providing healthy revenue visibility for the coming quarters.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current order book stands at ₹565.80 Cr, providing healthy revenue visibility for the coming quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: The additional capacity is expected to support execution of our growing order book and enable us to participate in larger and higher-capacity transformer opportunities.
orders_capacity.quote: The additional capacity is expected to support execution of our growing order book and enable us to participate in larger and higher-capacity transformer opportunities.

orders_capacity.claim: The order book stood at INR 590.06 crores as of August 13, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our order book stands at INR590.06 crores as of August 13, 2026, providing healthy execution visibility over the coming quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: Supreme Power secured 10 orders worth INR 195.64 crores in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: We secured 10 orders aggregating INR195.64 crores during Q1 FY27 with the execution time lines ranging between 7 months to 17 months.

orders_capacity.claim: Power transformers constitute 76.91% of the order book at INR 453.83 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: From the product perspective, power transformers constitute the largest share on the order book at INR453.83 crores, representing approximately 76.91%.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the new plant is currently at 20% to 25%.
orders_capacity.quote: The new plant, our capacity is almost 20% to 25% utilization as of now. We are utilizing 20% to 25%.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the new facility is expected to reach 30% to 50% in Q4 FY27.

capital_allocation.claim: Supreme Power has approached banks to increase working capital credit limits.
capital_allocation.quote: Now we have approached the banks for higher limits. And inventory, at least 2 months -- 2 to 2.5 months inventory, we have to hold.

capital_allocation.claim: The debtor cycle is expected to be between 80 to 100 days.
capital_allocation.quote: Debtors cycle will be around 90 to 100 days -- 80 to 100 days.

capital_allocation.claim: The company plans to raise bank term loans to fund the capex for its tank manufacturing facility.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, we will be raising term loans for that.

capital_allocation.claim: Supreme Power has no plans for equity dilution in the current financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: So for this year, there is no requirement for equity dilution.

risks_headwinds.claim: Timing differences between input cost increases and price variation clause adjustments can impact margins.
risks_headwinds.quote: These movements can impact margins, especially where there is a timing difference between increase in input costs and the corresponding adjustment under the price variation clause.

risks_headwinds.claim: Project execution delays on the customer side may impact planned delivery schedules.
risks_headwinds.quote: Because their customers, they are placing order 1 year before. So there may be some delay in the project or the progress of the project.

risks_headwinds.claim: Higher employee overhead costs and expenses are absorbing potential gross margin gains.
risks_headwinds.quote: No. Since we are more focusing on power transformers, we are -- we believe we will get little 1% or 2% more margin. But this margin will be absorbed by the overheads.

management_commitments.quote: Yes, yes. It is expected in next year.

management_commitments.quote: And next year, almost 80%, I think we should utilize.

management_commitments.claim: Management believes the company will receive PGCIL approval within a year.
management_commitments.quote: So, this year, within a year, we should -- we believe we should get the PGCIL approval.

management_commitments.claim: Supreme Power expects to complete its tank manufacturing facility before March.
management_commitments.quote: I think before March, I think this facility will complete.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets a minimum 30% year-on-year revenue increase.
management_commitments.quote: Year-on-year, 30% -- minimum 30% rise will be there on the revenue.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to open the window to migrate to the main board after December.
